pli-tv-kd5:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
pli-tv-kd5:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro asītiyā gāmasahassesu issarādhipaccaṃ rajjaṃ kāreti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.1.3: tena kho pana samayena Campāyaṃ Soṇo nāma Koḷiviso seṭṭhiputto sukhumālo hoti,
pli-tv-kd5:1.1.5: atha kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro tāni asītiṃ gāmikasahassāni sannipātāpetvā kenacid eva karaṇīyena Soṇassa Koḷivisassa santike dūtaṃ pāhesi,
pli-tv-kd5:1.1.6: āgacchatu Soṇo icchāmi Soṇassa āgatan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd5:1.2.1: atha kho Soṇassa Koḷivisassa mātāpitaro Soṇaṃ Koḷivisaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd5:1.2.2: rājā te tāta Soṇa pāde dakkhitukāmo.
pli-tv-kd5:1.2.3: mā kho tvaṃ tāta Soṇa yena rājā tena pāde abhippasāreyyāsi,
pli-tv-kd5:1.2.6: atha kho Soṇaṃ Koḷivisaṃ sivikāya ānesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:1.2.7: atha kho Soṇo Koḷiviso yena rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā rājānaṃ Māgadhaṃ Seniyaṃ Bimbisāraṃ abhivādetvā rañño purato pallaṅkena nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd5:1.2.8: addasa kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro Soṇassa Koḷivisassa pādatalesu lomāni jātāni. ||2||
pli-tv-kd5:1.3.1: atha kho rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro tāni asītiṃ gāmikasahassāni diṭṭhadhammike atthe anusāsitvā uyyojesi:
pli-tv-kd5:1.3.2: tumhe khv' attha bhaṇe mayā diṭṭhadhammike atthe anusāsitā,
pli-tv-kd5:1.3.4: so no bhagavā samparāyike atthe anusāsissatīti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.3.5: atha kho tāni asīti gāmikasahassāni yena Gijjhakūṭo pabbato ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu. ||3||
pli-tv-kd5:1.4.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Sāgato bhagavato upaṭṭhāko hoti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.4.2: atha kho tāni asīti gāmikasahassāni yenāyasmā Sāgato ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Sāgataṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd5:1.4.3: imāni bhante asīti gāmikasahassāni idh' upasaṃkantāni bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
pli-tv-kd5:1.4.4: sādhu mayaṃ bhante labheyyāma bhagavantaṃ dassanāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.4.5: tena hi tumhe āyasmanto muhuttaṃ idh' eva tāva hotha yāvāhaṃ bhagavantaṃ paṭivedemīti. ||4||
pli-tv-kd5:1.5.1: atha kho āyasmā Sāgato tesaṃ asītiyā gāmikasahassānaṃ purato pekkhamānānaṃ pāṭikāya nimujjitvā bhagavato purato ummujjitvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd5:1.5.2: imāni bhante asīti gāmikasahassāni idh' upasaṃkantāni bhagavantaṃ dassanāya,
pli-tv-kd5:1.5.3: yassa dāni bhante bhagavā kālaṃ maññatīti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.5.4: tena hi tvaṃ Sāgata vihārapacchāyāyaṃ āsanaṃ paññāpehīti. ||5||
pli-tv-kd5:1.6.2: kho āyasmā Sāgato bhagavato paṭisuṇitvā pīṭhaṃ gahetvā bhagavato purato nimujjitvā tesaṃ asītiyā gāmikasahassānaṃ purato pekkhamānānaṃ pāṭikāya ummujjitvā vihārapacchāyāyaṃ āsanaṃ paññāpesi.
pli-tv-kd5:1.6.3: atha kho bhagavā vihārā nikkhamitvā vihārapacchāyāyaṃ paññatte āsane nisīdi. ||6||
pli-tv-kd5:1.7.1: atha kho tāni asīti gāmikasahassāni yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu .
pli-tv-kd5:1.7.2: atha kho tāni asīti gāmikasahassāni āyasmantaṃ yeva Sāgataṃ samannāharanti, no tathā bhagavantaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:1.7.3: atha kho bhagavā tesaṃ āsītiyā gāmikasahassānaṃ cetasā cetoparivitakkaṃ aññāya āyasmantaṃ Sāgataṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd5:1.7.4: tena hi tvaṃ Sāgata bhiyyosomattāya uttarimanussadhammaṃ iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ dassehīti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.7.5: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho āyasmā Sāgato bhagavato paṭisuṇitvā vehāsaṃ abbhuggantvā ākāse antalikkhe caṅkamati pi tiṭṭhati pi nisīdati pi seyyam pi kappeti dhūpāyati pi pajjalati pi antaradhāyati pi. ||7||
pli-tv-kd5:1.8.1: atha kho āyasmā Sāgato ākāse antalikkhe anekavihitaṃ uttarimanussadhammaṃ iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ dassetvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd5:1.8.6: atha kho tāni asīti gāmikasahassāni acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho,
pli-tv-kd5:1.8.7: sāvako pi nāma evaṃ mahiddhiko bhavissati evaṃ mahānubhāvo, aho nūna satthā 'ti bhagavantaṃ yeva samannāharanti, no tathā āyasmantaṃ Sāgataṃ. ||8||
pli-tv-kd5:1.9.1: atha kho bhagavā tesaṃ asītiyā gāmikasahassānaṃ cetasā cetoparivitakkaṃ aññāya anupubbikathaṃ kathesi seyyath' īdaṃ:
pli-tv-kd5:1.9.2: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
pli-tv-kd5:1.9.3: yadā te bhagavā aññāsi kallacitte muducitte vinīvaraṇacitte udaggacitte pasannacitte, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā taṃ pakāsesi,
pli-tv-kd5:1.9.5: seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammad eva rajanaṃ paṭigaṇheyya, evam
pli-tv-kd5:1.9.6: eva tesaṃ asītiyā gāmikasahassānaṃ tasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
pli-tv-kd5:1.9.7: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman ti. ||9||
pli-tv-kd5:1.10.1: te diṭṭhadhammā pattadhammā viditadhammā pariyogāḷhadhammā tiṇṇavicikicchā vigatakathaṃkathā vesārajjappattā aparappaccayā satthu sāsane bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd5:1.10.3: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya
pli-tv-kd5:1.10.6: ete mayaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāma
pli-tv-kd5:1.10.8: upāsake no bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupete saraṇaṃ gate 'ti. ||10||
pli-tv-kd5:1.11.1: atha kho Soṇassa Koḷivisassa etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd5:1.11.2: yathā -yathā kho ahaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, na yidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:1.11.3: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.11.4: atha kho tāni asīti gāmikasahassāni bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkamiṃsu. ||11||
pli-tv-kd5:1.12.1: atha kho Soṇo Koḷiviso acirapakkantesu tesu asītiyā gāmikasahassesu yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd5:1.12.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Soṇo Koḷiviso bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd5:1.12.3: yathā-yathāhaṃ bhante bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ . . . brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:1.12.4: icchām' ahaṃ bhante kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajituṃ,
pli-tv-kd5:1.12.6: alattha kho Soṇo Koḷiviso bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, alattha upasampadaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:1.12.7: acirūpasampanno ca panāyasmā Soṇo Sītavane viharati. ||12||
pli-tv-kd5:1.13.2: caṅkamo lohitena phuṭo hoti seyyathāpi gavāghātanaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:1.13.3: atha kho āyasmato Soṇassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd5:1.13.4: ye kho keci bhagavato sāvakā āraddhaviriyā viharanti, ahaṃ tesaṃ aññataro,
pli-tv-kd5:1.13.5: atha ca pana me nānupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati,
pli-tv-kd5:1.13.6: saṃvijjanti kho pana me kule bhogā.
pli-tv-kd5:1.13.7: sakkā bhoge ca bhuñjituṃ puññāni ca kātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:1.13.8: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ hīnāyāvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjeyyaṃ puññāni ca kareyyan ti. ||13||
pli-tv-kd5:1.14.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmato Soṇassa cetasā cetoparivitakkaṃ aññāya
pli-tv-kd5:1.14.2: seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam eva Gijjhakūṭe pabbate antarahito Sītavane pāturahosi.
pli-tv-kd5:1.14.3: atha kho bhagavā sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ senāsanacārikaṃ āhiṇḍanto yenāyasmato Soṇassa caṅkamo ten' upasaṃkami.
pli-tv-kd5:1.14.4: addasa kho bhagavā āyasmato Soṇassa caṅkamaṃ lohitena phuṭaṃ, disvāna bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd5:1.14.5: kassa nv āyaṃ bhikkhave caṅkamo lohitena phuṭo seyyathāpi gavāghātanan ti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.14.6: āyasmato bhante Soṇassa accāraddhaviriyassa caṅkamato pādā bhijjiṃsu,
pli-tv-kd5:1.14.7: tassāyaṃ caṅkamo lohitena phuṭo seyyathāpi gavāghātanan ti. ||14||
pli-tv-kd5:1.15.1: atha kho bhagavā yenāyasmato Soṇassa vihāro ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd5:1.15.2: āyasmāpi kho Soṇo bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd5:1.15.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Soṇaṃ bhagavā etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd5:1.15.4: nanu te Soṇa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd5:1.15.11: taṃ kiṃ maññasi Soṇa, kusalo tvaṃ pubbe agārikabhūto vīṇāya tantissare 'ti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.15.13: taṃ kiṃ maññasi Soṇa, yadā te vīṇāya tantiyo accāyatā honti, api nu te vīṇā tasmiṃ samaye saravatī vā hoti kammaññā vā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.16.1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi Soṇa, yadā te vīṇāya tantiyo atisithilā honti, api nu te vīṇā tasmiṃ samaye saravatī vā hoti kammaññā vā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.16.3: taṃ kiṃ maññasi Soṇa, yadā te vīṇāya tantiyo n' eva accāyatā honti nātisithilā same guṇe patiṭṭhitā, api nu te vīṇā tasmiṃ samaye saravatī va hoti kammaññā vā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.16.5: evam eva kho Soṇa accāraddhaviriyaṃ uddhaccāya saṃvattati, atilīnaviriyaṃ kosajjāya saṃvattati. ||16||
pli-tv-kd5:1.17.1: tasmāt iha tvaṃ Soṇa viriyasamataṃ adhiṭṭhaha indriyānaṃ ca samataṃ paṭivijjha tattha ca nimittaṃ gaṇhāhīti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.17.2: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho āyasmā Soṇo bhagavato paccassosi.
pli-tv-kd5:1.17.3: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Soṇaṃ iminā ovādena ovaditvā seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam eva Sītavane āyasmato Soṇassa sammukhe antarahito Gijjhakūṭe pabbate pāturahosi. ||17||
pli-tv-kd5:1.18.1: atha kho āyasmā Soṇo aparena samayena viriyasamataṃ adhiṭṭhāsi indriyānaṃ ca samataṃ paṭivijjhi tattha ca nimittaṃ aggahesi.
pli-tv-kd5:1.18.2: atha kho āyasmā Soṇo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirass' eva yass' atthāya kulaputtā sammad eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tad anuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi,
pli-tv-kd5:1.18.3: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā 'ti abbhaññāsi,
pli-tv-kd5:1.18.4: aññataro ca panāyasmā Soṇo arahataṃ ahosi. ||18||
pli-tv-kd5:1.19.1: atha kho āyasmato Soṇassa arahattaṃ pattassa etad ahosi: yaṃ
pli-tv-kd5:1.19.2: nūnāhaṃ bhagavato santike aññaṃ vyākareyyan ti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.19.3: atha kho āyasmā Soṇo yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-kd5:1.19.4: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Soṇo bhagavantam etad avoca: ||19||
pli-tv-kd5:1.20.1: yo so bhante bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano sammadaññāvimutto, so cha ṭṭhānāni adhimutto hoti:
pli-tv-kd5:1.20.2: nekkhammādhimutto hoti, pavivekādhimutto hoti, avyāpajjhādhimutto hoti, upādānakkhayādhimutto hoti, taṇhakkhayādhimutto hoti, asammohādhimutto hoti. ||20||
pli-tv-kd5:1.21.1: siyā kho pana bhante idh' ekaccassa āyasmato evam assa:
pli-tv-kd5:1.21.2: kevalaṃ saddhāmattakaṃ nūna ayam āyasmā nissāya nekkhammādhimutto 'ti. na kho pan' etaṃ bhante evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:1.21.3: khīṇāsavo bhante bhikkhu vusitavā katakaraṇīyo karaṇīyam attānaṃ asamanupassanto katassa vā paṭicayaṃ khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā nekkhammādhimutto hoti, khayā dosassa vītadosattā nekkhammādhimutto hoti, khayā mohassa vītamohattā nekkhammādhimutto hoti. ||21||
pli-tv-kd5:1.22.1: siyā kho pana bhante idh' ekaccassa āyasmato evam assa:
pli-tv-kd5:1.22.2: lābhasakkārasilokaṃ nūna ayam āyasmā nikāmayamāno pavivekādhimutto 'ti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.22.4: khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā pavivekādhimutto hoti, khayā dosassa vītadosattā pavivekādhimutto hoti, khayā mohassa vītamohattā pavivekādhimutto hoti. ||22||
pli-tv-kd5:1.23.1: siyā kho pana bhante idh' ekaccassa āyasmato evam assa:
pli-tv-kd5:1.23.2: sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ nūna ayam āyasmā sārato paccāgacchanto avyāpajjhādhimutto 'ti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.23.4: khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā avyāpajjhādhimutto hoti, khayā dosassa vītadosattā avyāpajjhādhimutto hoti, khayā mohassa vītamohattā avyāpajjhādhimutto hoti, ||23||
pli-tv-kd5:1.24.1: khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā upādānakkhayādhimutto hoti, khayā dosassa vītadosattā upādānakkhayādhimutto hoti, khayā mohassa vītamohattā upādānakkhayādhimutto hoti,
pli-tv-kd5:1.24.2: khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā taṇhakkhayādhimutto hoti, khayā dosassa vītadosattā taṇhakkhayādhimutto hoti, khayā mohassa vītamohattā taṇhakkhayādhimutto hoti,
pli-tv-kd5:1.24.3: khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā asammohādhimutto hoti, khayā dosassa vītadosattā asammohādhimutto hoti, khayā mohassa vītamohattā asammohādhimutto hoti. ||24||
pli-tv-kd5:1.25.1: evaṃ sammāvimuttacittassa bhante bhikkhuno bhusā ce pi cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā cakkhussa āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, n' ev' assa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti,
pli-tv-kd5:1.25.2: amissikatam ev' assa cittaṃ hoti ṭhitaṃ ānejjappattaṃ vayañ c' assānupassati.
pli-tv-kd5:1.25.7: manoviññeyyā dhammā manassa āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, n' ev' assa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti,
pli-tv-kd5:1.25.8: amissikatam ev' assa cittaṃ hoti ṭhitaṃ ānejjappattaṃ vayañ c' assānupassati. ||25||
pli-tv-kd5:1.26.1: seyyathāpi bhante selo pabbato acchiddo asusiro ekaghano puratthimāya ce pi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi, n' eva naṃ saṃkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampavedheyya,
pli-tv-kd5:1.26.4: dakkhiṇāya ce pi disāya . . . na sampavedheyya,
pli-tv-kd5:1.26.5: evam eva kho bhante evaṃ sammāvimuttacittassa bhikkhuno bhusā ce pi cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā . . .
pli-tv-kd5:1.26.11: manoviññeyyā dhammā manassa āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, n' ev' assa cittam . . .
pli-tv-kd5:1.28.2: evaṃ kho bhikkhave kulaputtā aññaṃ vyākaronti. attho ca vutto attā ca anupanīto.
pli-tv-kd5:1.28.3: atha ca pan' idh' ekacce moghapurisā hasamānakaṃ maññe aññaṃ vyākaronti, te pacchā vighātaṃ āpajjantīti. ||28||
pli-tv-kd5:1.29.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Soṇaṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd5:1.29.3: anujānāmi te Soṇa ekapalāsikaṃ upāhanan ti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.29.4: ahaṃ kho bhante asītisakaṭavāhe hiraññaṃ ohāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito sattahatthikañ ca anīkaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:1.29.5: tassa me bhavissanti vattāro: Soṇo Koḷiviso asītisakaṭavāhe hiraññaṃ ohāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito sattahatthikañ ca anīkaṃ,
pli-tv-kd5:1.29.6: so dān' āyaṃ ekapalāsikāsu upāhanāsu satto 'ti. ||29||
pli-tv-kd5:1.30.1: sace bhagavā bhikkhusaṃghassa anujānissati, aham pi paribhuñjissāmi,
pli-tv-kd5:1.30.2: no ce bhagavā bhikkhusaṃghassa anujānissati, aham pi na paribhuñjissāmīti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.30.3: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd5:2.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū sabbanīlikā upāhanāyo dhārenti --la--
pli-tv-kd5:2.1.12: na sabbapītikā upāhanā dhāretabbā . . . na sabbamahānāmarattā upāhanā dhāretabbā.
pli-tv-kd5:2.2.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū nīlakavaṭṭikā upāhanāyo dhārenti, pītakavaṭṭikā
pli-tv-kd5:2.2.2: up. dh., lohitakavaṭṭikā up. dh., mañjeṭṭhakavaṭṭikā up. dh., kaṇhavaṭṭikā up. dh., mahāraṅgarattavaṭṭikā up. dh., mahānāmarattavaṭṭikā up. dhārenti.
pli-tv-kd5:2.2.6: na bhikkhave nīlakavaṭṭikā upāhanā dhāretabbā . . . na mahānāmarattavaṭṭikā upāhanā dhāretabbā.
pli-tv-kd5:2.3.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū khallakabaddhā upāhanāyo dhārenti, puṭabaddhā up. dhārenti, pāliguṇṭhimā up. dh., tūlapuṇṇikā up. dh., tittirapattikā up. dh., meṇḍavisāṇabandhikā up. dh., ajavisāṇabandhikā up. dh., vicchikālikā up. dh., morapicchaparisibbitā up. dh., citrā up. dhārenti.
pli-tv-kd5:2.4.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū sīhacammaparikkhaṭā upāhanāyo dhārenti, vyagghacammaparikkhaṭā up. dh., dīpicammap. up. dh., ajinacammap. up. dh., uddacammap. up. dh., majjāricammap. up. dh., kāḷakacammap. up. dh., ulūkacammap. up. dhārenti.
pli-tv-kd5:3.1.1: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya Rājagahaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi aññatarena bhikkhunā pacchāsamaṇena.
pli-tv-kd5:3.1.2: atha kho so bhikkhu khañjamāno bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito-piṭṭhito anubandhi.
pli-tv-kd5:3.1.3: addasa kho aññataro upāsako gaṇaṃgaṇūpāhanaṃ ārohitvā bhagavantaṃ dūrato 'va āgacchantaṃ,
pli-tv-kd5:3.1.4: disvā upāhanā orohitvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā yena so bhikkhu ten' upasaṃkami,
pli-tv-kd5:3.1.5: upasaṃkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ abhivādetvā etad avoca: ||1||
pli-tv-kd5:3.2.6: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd5:4.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā ajjhokāse anupāhano caṅkamati.
pli-tv-kd5:4.1.4: chabbaggiyā bhikkhū satthari anupāhane caṅkamamāne theresu pi bhikkhūsu anupāhanesu caṅkamamānesu saupāhanā caṅkamanti.
pli-tv-kd5:4.1.5: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd5:4.1.6: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū satthari anupāhane caṅkamamāne theresu pi bhikkhūsu anupāhanesu caṅkamamānesu saupāhanā caṅkamissantīti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd5:4.2.1: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:4.2.2: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhū satthari . . . saupāhanā caṅkamantīti.
pli-tv-kd5:4.2.5: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā satthari . . . saupāhanā caṅkamissanti.
pli-tv-kd5:4.2.6: ime hi nāma bhikkhave gihī odātavasanā abhijīvanikassa sippassa kāraṇā ācariyesu sagāravā sappatissā sabhāgavuttikā viharissanti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd5:4.3.1: idha kho taṃ bhikkhave sobhetha yaṃ tumhe evaṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye pabbajitā samānā ācariyesu ācariyamattesu upajjhāyesu upajjhāyamattesu sagāravā sappatissā sabhāgavuttikā vihareyyātha.
pli-tv-kd5:4.3.2: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --la--
pli-tv-kd5:4.3.5: na bhikkhave ācariyesu ācariyamattesu upajjhāyesu upajjhāyamattesu anupāhanesu caṅkamamānesu saupāhanena caṅkamitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:4.3.7: na ca bhikkhave ajjhārāme upāhanā dhāretabbā.
pli-tv-kd5:5.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno pādakhīlābādho hoti.
pli-tv-kd5:5.1.2: taṃ bhikkhuṃ pariggahetvā uccāram pi passāvam pi nikkhāmenti.
pli-tv-kd5:5.1.3: addasa kho bhagavā senāsanacārikaṃ āhiṇḍanto te bhikkhū taṃ bhikkhuṃ pariggahetvā uccāram pi passāvam pi nikkhāmente, disvāna yena te bhikkhū ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā te bhikkhū etad avoca: ||1||
pli-tv-kd5:5.2.3: imaṃ mayaṃ pariggahetvā uccāram pi passāvam pi nikkhāmemā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd5:5.2.4: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd5:5.2.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave yassa pādā vā dukkhā pādā vā phālitā pādakhīlā vā ābādho upāhanaṃ dhāretun ti. ||2||5||
pli-tv-kd5:6.1.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū adhotehi pādehi mañcam pi pīṭham pi abhirūhanti,
pli-tv-kd5:6.1.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave idāni mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā abhirūhissāmīti upāhanaṃ dhāretun ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd5:6.2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū rattiyā uposathaggam pi sannisajjam pi gacchantā andhakāre khānum pi kaṇṭakam pi akkamanti, pādā dukkhā honti.
pli-tv-kd5:6.2.3: anujānāmi bhikkhave ajjhārāme upāhanaṃ dhāretuṃ ukkaṃ padīpaṃ kattaradaṇḍan ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd5:6.3.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya kaṭṭhapādukāyo abhirūhitvā ajjhokāse caṅkamanti uccāsaddā mahāsaddā khaṭakhaṭasaddā anekavihitaṃ tiracchānakathaṃ kathentā seyyath' īdaṃ:
pli-tv-kd5:6.3.2: rājakathaṃ, corakathaṃ, mahāmattak., senāk., bhayak., yuddhak., annak., pānak., vatthak., sayanak., mālāk., gandhak., ñātik., yānak., gāmak., nigamak., nagarak., janapadak., itthik., sūrak., visikhāk., kumbhaṭṭhānak., pubbapetak., nānatthak., lokakkhāyikaṃ samuddakkhāyikaṃ itibhavābhavakathaṃ iti vā
pli-tv-kd5:6.3.3: kīṭakam pi akkamitvā mārenti bhikkhū pi samādhimhā cāventi. ||3||
pli-tv-kd5:6.4.1: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd5:6.4.2: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya kaṭṭhapādukāyo abhirūhitvā ajjhokāse caṅkamissanti uccāsaddā . . .
pli-tv-kd5:6.4.4: akkamitvā māressanti bhikkhū pi samādhimhā cāvessantīti.
pli-tv-kd5:6.4.5: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:6.4.6: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhū rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya kaṭṭhapādukāyo abhirūhitvā ajjhokāse caṅkamanti uccāsaddā . . .
pli-tv-kd5:6.4.8: akkamitvā mārenti bhikkhū pi samādhimhā cāventīti.
pli-tv-kd5:7.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Rājagahe yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Bārāṇasī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd5:7.1.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Bārāṇasī tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd5:7.1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati Isipatane migadāye.
pli-tv-kd5:7.1.4: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū
pli-tv-kd5:7.1.9: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā tālataruṇe chedāpetvā tālapattapādukāyo dhāressanti,
pli-tv-kd5:7.2.1: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:7.2.2: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:7.2.3: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhū tālataruṇe chedāpetvā tālapattapādukāyo dhārenti,
pli-tv-kd5:7.2.7: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā tālataruṇe chedāpetvā tālapattapādukāyo dhāressanti,
pli-tv-kd5:7.2.10: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --la--

pli-tv-kd5:8.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Bārāṇasiyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Bhaddiyaṃ tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd5:8.1.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Bhaddiyaṃ tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd5:8.1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Bhaddiye viharati Jātiyāvane.
pli-tv-kd5:8.1.4: tena kho pana samayena Bhaddiyā bhikkhū anekavihitaṃ pādukaṃ maṇḍanānuyogam anuyuttā viharanti, tiṇapādukaṃ karonti pi kārāpenti pi, muñjapād. k. pi k. pi, babbajapād. k. pi k. pi, hintālapād. k. pi k. pi, kamalapād. k. pi k. pi, kambalapād. k. pi k. pi, riñcanti uddesaṃ paripucchaṃ adhisīlaṃ adhicittaṃ adhipaññaṃ. ||1||
pli-tv-kd5:8.2.1: ye te bhikkhū appicchā, te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd5:8.2.2: kathaṃ hi nāma Bhaddiyā bhikkhū anekavihitaṃ pādukaṃ maṇḍanānuyogam anuyuttā viharissanti, tiṇapādukaṃ karissanti pi kārāpessanti pi . . . riñcissanti uddesaṃ paripucchaṃ adhisīlaṃ adhicittaṃ adhipaññan ti.
pli-tv-kd5:8.2.3: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:8.2.4: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave Bhaddiyā bhikkhū anekavihitaṃ pādukaṃ maṇḍanānuyogam anuyuttā viharanti, tiṇapādukaṃ karonti pi kārāpenti pi --la--
pli-tv-kd5:8.2.8: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā anekavihitaṃ pādukaṃ maṇḍanānuyogam anuyuttā viharissanti, tiṇapādukaṃ karissanti pi kārāpessanti pi -- la
pli-tv-kd5:8.3.1: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya. ||2||
pli-tv-kd5:8.3.4: na bhikkhave tiṇapādukā dhāretabbā, na muñjapādukā dhāretabbā, na babbajap. dh., na hintālap. dh., na kamalap. dh., na kambalap. dh., na sovaṇṇamayā p. dh., na rūpiyamayā p. dh., na maṇimayā p. dh., na veḷuriyamayā p. dh., na phalikamayā p. dh., na kaṃsamayā p. dh., na kācamayā p. dh., na tipumayā p. dh., na sīsamayā p. dh., na tambalohamayā p. dhāretabbā.
pli-tv-kd5:8.3.6: na ca bhikkhave kāci saṃkamanīyā pādukā dhāretabbā.
pli-tv-kd5:8.3.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave tisso pādukāyo dhuvaṭṭhāniyā asaṃkamanīyāyo,
pli-tv-kd5:9.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Bhaddiye yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Sāvatthi tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd5:9.1.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Sāvatthi tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd5:9.1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-kd5:9.1.4: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū Aciravatiyā nadiyā gāvīnaṃ tarantīnaṃ visāṇesu pi gaṇhanti, kaṇṇesu pi gaṇhanti, gīvāya pi gaṇhanti, cheppāya pi gaṇhanti, piṭṭhim pi abhirūhanti, rattacittāpi aṅgajātaṃ chupanti, vacchatarī pi ogāhetvā mārenti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd5:9.2.2: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā gāvīnaṃ tarantīnaṃ visāṇesu pi gahessanti --gha--
pli-tv-kd5:9.2.4: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:9.2.5: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:9.3.4: na bhikkhave gāvīnaṃ visāṇesu gahetabbaṃ, na kaṇṇesu gahetabbaṃ, na gīvāya gahetabbaṃ, na cheppāya gahetabbaṃ, na piṭṭhī abhirūhitabbā.
pli-tv-kd5:9.3.6: na ca bhikkhave rattacittena aṅgajātaṃ chupitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:9.4.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū yānena yāyanti, itthiyuttena pi purisantarena, purisayuttena pi itthantarena.
pli-tv-kd5:10.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu Kosalesu janapadesu Sāvatthiṃ gacchanto bhagavantaṃ dassanāya antarā magge gilāno hoti.
pli-tv-kd5:10.1.2: atha kho so bhikkhu maggā okkamma aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd5:10.1.3: manussā taṃ bhikkhuṃ disvā etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd5:10.1.5: Sāvatthiṃ kho ahaṃ āvuso gamissāmi bhagavantaṃ dassanāyā 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd5:10.2.4: alaṃ āvuso paṭikkhittaṃ bhagavatā yānan ti kukkuccāyanto yānaṃ nābhirūhi.
pli-tv-kd5:10.2.5: atha kho so bhikkhu Sāvatthiṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd5:10.3.2: itthiyuttaṃ nu kho purisayuttaṃ nu kho 'ti.
pli-tv-kd5:10.3.5: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno yānugghātena bāḷhataraṃ aphāsu ahosi.
pli-tv-kd5:10.4.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uccāsayanamahāsayanāni dhārenti seyyath' īdaṃ:
pli-tv-kd5:10.4.2: āsandiṃ, pallaṅkaṃ, goṇakaṃ, cittakaṃ, paṭikaṃ, paṭalikaṃ, tūlikaṃ, vikatikaṃ, uddhalomiṃ, ekantalomiṃ, kaṭṭhissaṃ, koseyyaṃ, kuttakaṃ, hatthattharaṃ, assattharaṃ, rathattharaṃ, ajinappaveṇiṃ, kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇaṃ, sauttaracchadaṃ, ubhatolohitakūpadhānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:10.4.3: manussā vihāracārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā passitvā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd5:10.5.1: na bhikkhave uccāsayanamahāsayanāni dhāretabbāni seyyath' īdaṃ:
pli-tv-kd5:10.5.2: āsandi, pallaṅko, goṇako, cittakā, paṭikā, paṭalikā, tūlikā, vikatikā, uddhalomī, ekantalomī, kaṭṭhissaṃ, koseyyaṃ, kuttakaṃ, hatthattharaṃ, assattharaṃ, rathattharaṃ, ajinappaveṇi, kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇaṃ, sauttaracchadaṃ, ubhatolohitakūpadhānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:10.6.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū
pli-tv-kd5:10.6.4: tāni mañcappamāṇena pi chinnāni honti, pīṭhappamāṇena pi chinnāni honti, anto pi mañce paññattāni honti, bahi pi mañce paññattāni honti, anto pi pīṭhe paññattāni honti, bahi pi pīṭhe paññattāni honti.
pli-tv-kd5:10.6.5: manussā vihāracārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā passitvā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd5:10.6.8: na bhikkhave mahācammāni dhāretabbāni, sīhacammaṃ, vyagghacammaṃ, dīpicammaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:10.7.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū
pli-tv-kd5:10.7.4: tāni mañcappamāṇena pi chinnāni honti . . . bahi pi pīṭhe paññattāni honti. aññataro
pli-tv-kd5:10.7.6: atha kho so pāpabhikkhu pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena tassa pāpupāsakassa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd5:10.7.7: atha kho so pāpupāsako yena so pāpabhikkhu ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā taṃ pāpabhikkhuṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ||7||
pli-tv-kd5:10.8.1: tena kho pana samayena tassa pāpupāsakassa vacchako hoti taruṇako abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko citro seyyathāpi dīpicchāpo.
pli-tv-kd5:10.8.2: atha kho so pāpabhikkhu taṃ vacchakaṃ sakkaccaṃ upanijjhāyati.
pli-tv-kd5:10.8.3: atha kho so pāpupāsako taṃ pāpabhikkhuṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd5:10.8.4: kissa bhante ayyo imaṃ vacchakaṃ sakkaccaṃ upanijjhāyatīti.
pli-tv-kd5:10.8.5: attho me āvuso imassa vacchakassa cammenā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd5:10.8.6: atha kho so pāpupāsako taṃ vacchakaṃ vadhitvā cammaṃ vidhūnitvā tassa pāpabhikkhuno pādāsi.
pli-tv-kd5:10.8.7: atha kho so pāpabhikkhu taṃ cammaṃ saṃghāṭiyā paṭicchādetvā agamāsi. ||8||
pli-tv-kd5:10.9.1: atha kho sā gāvī vacchagiddhinī taṃ pāpabhikkhuṃ piṭṭhito-piṭṭhito anubandhi.
pli-tv-kd5:10.9.3: kissa ty āyaṃ āvuso gāvī piṭṭhito-piṭṭhito anubaddhā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd5:10.9.4: aham pi kho āvuso na jānāmi kena my āyaṃ gāvī piṭṭhito-piṭṭhito anubaddhā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd5:10.9.5: tena kho pana samayena tassa pāpabhikkhuno saṃghāṭī lohitena makkhitā hoti.
pli-tv-kd5:10.9.7: ayaṃ pana te avuso saṃghāṭī kiṃ katā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd5:10.9.8: atha kho so pāpabhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd5:10.9.9: kiṃ pana tvaṃ āvuso pāṇātipāte samādapesīti.
pli-tv-kd5:10.9.11: ye te bhikkhū appicchā, te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd5:10.9.12: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhu pāṇātipāte samādapessati. nanu bhagavatā anekapariyāyena pāṇātipāto garahito pāṇātipātā veramaṇī pasatthā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd5:10.9.13: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. ||9||
pli-tv-kd5:10.10.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā taṃ pāpabhikkhuṃ paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-kd5:10.10.2: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ bhikkhu pāṇātipāte samādapesīti.
pli-tv-kd5:10.10.4: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa pāṇātipāte samādapessasi. nanu mayā moghapurisa anekapariyāyena pāṇātipāto garahito, pāṇātipātā veramaṇī pasatthā.
pli-tv-kd5:10.10.5: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya.
pli-tv-kd5:10.10.6: vigarahitvā dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd5:10.10.11: na ca bhikkhave kiñci cammaṃ dhāretabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:11.1.1: tena kho pana samayena manussānaṃ mañcam pi pīṭham pi cammonaddhāni honti cammavinaddhāni.
pli-tv-kd5:11.1.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave gihivikataṃ abhinisīdituṃ, na tv eva abhinipajjitun ti.
pli-tv-kd5:11.1.5: tena kho pana samayena vihārā cammabandhehi ogumphiyanti.
pli-tv-kd5:12.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū saupāhanā gāmaṃ pavisanti.
pli-tv-kd5:12.1.7: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu gilāno hoti, na sakkoti upāhanena vinā gāmaṃ pavisituṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:12.1.9: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānena bhikkhunā saupāhanena gāmaṃ pavisitun ti. ||1||12||
pli-tv-kd5:13.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Mahākaccāno Avantīsu viharati Kuraraghare Papāte pabbate.
pli-tv-kd5:13.1.2: tena kho pana samayena Soṇo upāsako Kuṭikaṇṇo āyasmato Mahākaccānassa upaṭṭhāko hoti.
pli-tv-kd5:13.1.3: atha kho Soṇo upāsako Kuṭikaṇṇo yenāyasmā Mahākaccāno ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Mahākaccānaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd5:13.1.4: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Soṇo upāsako Kuṭikaṇṇo āyasmantaṃ Mahākaccānaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd5:13.1.5: yathā-yathāhaṃ bhante ayyena Mahākaccānena dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, na yidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:13.1.6: icchām' ahaṃ bhante kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajituṃ,
pli-tv-kd5:13.2.1: dukkaraṃ kho Soṇa yāvajīvaṃ ekaseyyaṃ ekabhattaṃ brahmacariyaṃ,
pli-tv-kd5:13.2.2: iṅgha tvaṃ Soṇa tatth' eva agārikabhūto buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ anuyuñja kālayuttaṃ ekaseyyaṃ ekabhattaṃ brahmacariyan ti.
pli-tv-kd5:13.2.3: atha kho Soṇassa upāsakassa Kuṭikaṇṇassa yo ahosi pabbajjābhisaṃkhāro so paṭippassambhi.
pli-tv-kd5:13.2.4: dutiyam pi kho Soṇo upāsako Kuṭikaṇṇo --la--
pli-tv-kd5:13.2.5: tatiyam pi kho Soṇo up. Kuṭ. yenāyasmā Mahākaccāno ten'
pli-tv-kd5:13.2.10: atha kho āyasmā Mahākaccāno Soṇaṃ upāsakaṃ Kuṭikaṇṇaṃ pabbājesi.
pli-tv-kd5:13.2.11: tena kho pana samayena Avantidakkhiṇāpatho appabhikkhuko hoti.
pli-tv-kd5:13.2.12: atha kho āyasmā Mahākaccāno tiṇṇaṃ vassānaṃ accayena kicchena kasirena tato-tato dasavaggaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā āyasmantaṃ Soṇaṃ upasampādesi. ||2||
pli-tv-kd5:13.3.1: atha kho āyasmato Soṇassa vassaṃ vutthassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivatakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd5:13.3.2: suto yeva kho me so bhagavā ediso ca ediso cā 'ti na ca mayā sammukhā diṭṭho. gaccheyyāhaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ sace maṃ upajjhāyo anujāneyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd5:13.3.3: atha kho āyasmā Soṇo sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā Mahākaccāno ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā ayasmantaṃ Mahākaccānaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
pli-tv-kd5:13.4.1: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Soṇo āyasmantaṃ Mahākaccānaṃ etad avoca: ||3||
pli-tv-kd5:13.4.2: idha mayhaṃ bhante rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd5:13.4.3: suto yeva kho me so bhagavā ediso ca ediso cā 'ti, na ca mayā sammukhā diṭṭho. gaccheyyāhaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ sace maṃ upajjhāyo anujāneyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd5:13.4.4: gaccheyyāhaṃ bhante taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ sace maṃ upajjhāyo anujānātīti.
pli-tv-kd5:13.4.6: gaccha tvaṃ Soṇa taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ. ||4||
pli-tv-kd5:13.5.1: dakkhissasi tvaṃ Soṇa taṃ bhagavantaṃ pāsādikaṃ pasādanīyaṃ santindriyaṃ santamānasaṃ uttamadamathasamathaṃ anuppattaṃ dantaṃ guttaṃ yatindriyaṃ nāgaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:13.5.2: tena hi tvaṃ Soṇa mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vanda
pli-tv-kd5:13.5.3: upajjhāyo me bhante āyasmā Mahākaccāno bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatīti,
pli-tv-kd5:13.5.5: Avantidakkhiṇāpatho bhante appabhikkhuko, tiṇṇaṃ me vassānaṃ accayena kicchena kasirena tato-tato dasavaggaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā upasampadaṃ alatthaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:13.5.6: app eva nāma bhagavā Avantidakkhiṇāpathe appatarena gaṇena upasampadaṃ anujāneyya. ||5||
pli-tv-kd5:13.6.1: Avantidakkhiṇāpathe bhante kaṇhuttarā bhūmi kharā gokaṇṭakahatā.
pli-tv-kd5:13.6.2: app eva nāma bhagavā Avantidakkhiṇāpathe gaṇaṃgaṇūpāhanaṃ anujāneyya.
pli-tv-kd5:13.6.4: app eva nāma bhagavā Avantidakkhiṇāpathe dhuvanahānaṃ anujāneyya.
pli-tv-kd5:13.6.5: Avantidakkhiṇāpathe bhante cammāni attharaṇāni eḷakacammaṃ ajacammaṃ migacammaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:13.6.6: seyyathāpi bhante majjhimesu janapadesu eragu moragu majjhāru jantu,
pli-tv-kd5:13.6.7: evam eva kho bhante Avantidakkhiṇāpathe cammāni attharaṇāni eḷakacammaṃ ajacammaṃ migacammaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:13.6.8: app eva nāma bhagavā Avantidakkhiṇāpathe cammāni attharaṇāni anujāneyya eḷakacammaṃ ajacammaṃ migacammaṃ. ||6||
pli-tv-kd5:13.7.1: etarahi bhante manussā nissīmagatānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ cīvaraṃ denti
pli-tv-kd5:13.7.4: itthannāmehi te āvuso manussehi cīvaraṃ dinnan ti, te kukkuccāyantā na sādiyanti
pli-tv-kd5:13.7.6: app eva nāma bhagavā cīvare pariyāyaṃ ācikkheyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd5:13.7.8: kho āyasmā Soṇo āyasmato Mahākaccānassa paṭisuṇitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā āyasmantaṃ Mahākaccānaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Sāvatthi tena pakkāmi. ||7||
pli-tv-kd5:13.8.1: anupubbena yena Sāvatthi Jetavanaṃ Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāmo yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd5:13.8.2: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd5:13.8.5: yassa kho maṃ bhagavā āṇāpeti imassa Ānanda āgantukassa bhikkhuno senāsanaṃ paññāpehīti, icchati bhagavā tena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ ekavihāre vatthuṃ, icchati bhagavā āyasmatā Soṇena saddhiṃ ekavihāre vatthun ti
pli-tv-kd5:13.8.6: yasmiṃ vihāre bhagavā viharati tasmiṃ vihāre āyasmato Soṇassa senāsanaṃ paññāpesi. ||8||
pli-tv-kd5:13.9.1: atha kho bhagavā bahud eva rattiṃ ajjhokāse vītināmetvā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
pli-tv-kd5:13.9.2: āyasmāpi kho Soṇo bahud eva rattiṃ ajjhokāse vītināmetvā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
pli-tv-kd5:13.9.3: atha kho bhagavā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya āyasmantaṃ Soṇaṃ ajjhesi:
pli-tv-kd5:13.9.4: paṭibhātu taṃ bhikkhu dhammo bhāsitun ti.
pli-tv-kd5:13.9.5: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho āyasmā Soṇo bhagavato paṭisuṇitvā sabbān' eva aṭṭhakavaggikāni sarena abhāsi.
pli-tv-kd5:13.9.6: atha kho bhagavā āyasmato Soṇassa sarabhaññapariyosāne abbhanumodi:
pli-tv-kd5:13.9.8: suggahitāni kho te bhikkhu aṭṭhakavaggikāni sumanasikatāni sūpadhāritāni
pli-tv-kd5:13.9.9: kalyāṇiyāpi 'si vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya aneḷagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā.
pli-tv-kd5:13.10.1: kissa pana tvaṃ bhikkhu evaṃ ciraṃ akāsīti.
pli-tv-kd5:13.10.2: ciraṃ diṭṭho me bhante kāmesu ādīnavo, api ca sambādhā gharāvāsā bahukiccā bahukaraṇīyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd5:13.10.3: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
pli-tv-kd5:13.11.2: paṭisammodati kho maṃ bhagavā, ayaṃ khv assa kālo yaṃ me upajjhāyo paridassīti
pli-tv-kd5:13.11.3: uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-kd5:13.11.4: upajjhāyo me bhante āyasmā Mahākaccāno bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati evañ ca vadati: Avantidakkhiṇāpatho . . .
pli-tv-kd5:13.11.20: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd5:13.11.22: anujānāmi bhikkhave sabbapaccantimesu janapadesu vinayadharapañcamena gaṇena upasampadaṃ. ||11||
pli-tv-kd5:13.12.2: puratthimāya disāya Kajaṅgalaṃ nāma nigamo, tassa parena Mahāsālā, tato parā paccantimā janapadā, orato majjhe.
pli-tv-kd5:13.12.3: puratthimadakkhiṇāya disāya Sallavatī nāma nadī, tato parā paccantimā janapadā, orato majjhe.
pli-tv-kd5:13.12.4: dakkhiṇāya disāya Setakaṇṇikaṃ nāma nigamo, tato parā paccantimā janapadā, orato majjhe.
pli-tv-kd5:13.12.5: pacchimāya disāya Thūnaṃ nāma brāhmaṇagāmo, tato parā paccantimā janapadā, orato majjhe.
pli-tv-kd5:13.12.6: uttarāya disāya Usīraddhajo nāma pabbato, tato parā paccantimā janapadā, orato majjhe.
pli-tv-kd5:13.12.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave evarūpesu paccantimesu janapadesu vinayadharapañcamena gaṇena upasampadaṃ. ||12||
pli-tv-kd5:13.13.1: Avantidakkhiṇāpathe bhikkhave kaṇhuttarā bhūmi kharā gokaṇṭakahatā.
pli-tv-kd5:13.13.5: Avantidakkhiṇāpathe bhikkhave cammāni attharaṇāni eḷakacammaṃ ajacammaṃ migacammaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:13.13.6: seyyathāpi bhikkhave majjhimesu janapadesu eragu moragu majjhāru jantu,
pli-tv-kd5:13.13.7: evam eva kho bhikkhave Avantidakkhiṇāpathe cammāni attharaṇāni eḷakacammaṃ ajacammaṃ migacammaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:13.13.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave sabbapaccantimesu janapadesu cammāni attharaṇāni eḷakacammaṃ ajacammaṃ migacammaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:13.13.9: idha pana bhikkhave manussā nissīmagatānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ cīvaraṃ denti
pli-tv-kd5:13.13.11: anujānāmi bhikkhave sādituṃ. na tāva taṃ gaṇanūpagaṃ yāva na hatthaṃ gacchatīti. ||13||13|| cammakkhandhakaṃ pañcamaṃ. imamhi khandhake vatthu tesaṭṭhi.
